_comment: One entry per shipment. Keys starting with _ are ignored. Replaces the old allen_county_shipment_names.json and allen_county_stub_seeds.json -- both are folded in below.

_fields.name: Partner-facing display name. Falls back to the raw code if omitted.
_fields.identifier_prefix: The archive.org identifier prefix for this shipment (e.g. 'smithfam' for smithfam01, smithfam02, ...). Only needed to enable direct stub discovery for a shipment that isn't auto-detected.
_fields.number_width: Zero-padding width of the identifier's number suffix (e.g. 2 for 'smithfam01'). Only needed alongside identifier_prefix for a brand-new shipment with no items yet -- once at least one item exists the width is detected automatically.
_fields.number_start: First number in the sequence. Defaults to 1.
_fields.expected_items: Exact item count from the packing list/manifest, if known. This becomes the shipment's total on the dashboard even before any items are digitized -- this is what makes a newly-received shipment show up as '0 / N, awaiting digitization' instead of being invisible until archive.org has something to show.
_fields.received: Date the shipment arrived, YYYY-MM-DD. Required whenever expected_items is set, so the dashboard can show a brand-new shipment even though it has no activity yet.
_fields.closed: Set true if the shipment was cancelled/withdrawn and should stop appearing even with expected_items > 0 and no items.
_fields.notes: Free text, operator-only, never shown to the partner.
